name: holdfast
description: Hold your AI-coding session fast through any network drop. A zero-dependency local proxy that holds in-flight requests during VPN/wifi blips and replays them the instant the network returns — with managed, revertible routing for Claude Code (incl. Bedrock) and Kiro.

scripts.test: node test/integration.js && node test/streaming.js && node test/routing.js && node test/bedrock.js
